reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for the setup message layout change. CLI readiness: every setup `message` from init --json (approval, renewed code, connected, phone, device, plan, refused test notification, done, partial, stopped, declined, unreachable and the fallback) now puts one idea per paragraph separated by blank lines, with the code, link and action standing out. Links have names. The phone steps are numbered. The Codex /hooks approval is part of Codex's step in the done message. The 'I'll carry on once' and 'Tell me when' endings are gone. On macOS the done message, and the terminal's done note, end with the desktop app download link. The terminal keeps plain lines. Harness setup and the skill: the relay rule now says to send each message exactly as written, as the whole reply, keeping its line breaks, blank lines and Markdown, never quoted or in a code block, adding nothing but the QR. The install line no longer asks the User to allow prompts. installer-needs-you no longer asks the User to report back, and the cloud message puts the install command on its own line. Lifecycle hooks: unchanged. Domain terms: unchanged; no new terms. Outside setup, the doctor and ask Codex /hooks user_action is unchanged. Integration with current main: the additive response validators and development dependency patches already on main change no CLI call site, setup message, hook, skill text or domain term.
